title: Tall white children's play saucer

tellings.quote: a saucer that you might have for your children to take out to the play area, which I also saw. It's not meant to go faster than light.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years in the 1960s at the remote Indian Springs ranges in the Nevada desert, says he lived alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that besides their big ships, they had a small saucer meant for their children to take out to a play area, and that he saw it himself. He says it was not built to go faster than light, which would mean these visitors had craft of different sizes for everyday uses, just as we do.
